verdict.rationale: Snyk offers scanning that can run in CI/CD pipelines and a CLI, but there is no evidence of a scheduler, recurring job/workflow orchestration, or cron-like automation feature for AI-native users to define and run recurring jobs. CI/CD integration (snyk-gh-3) only means Snyk can be invoked from a pipeline someone else schedules, not that Snyk itself schedules recurring workflows.
